description: Threshold and precise state-policy nexus unresolved for the Jan. 10 Norq workforce protest; “several dozen” is below/unclear against the 50-person rule, while 80 refers to affected staff, not attendance.

The exact Azatutyun page is an audio item dated Jan. 13 whose headline identifies a government-directed pledge demand; its audio player has no available source and no transcript. Event onset, location, organizer, turnout, detailed demand and state response remain unknown.

Opened Aravot body confirms a Jan. 31 protest outside Yerevan Zoo and names three participants, while noting larger attendance had been expected but many stayed away. Total turnout and state-policy target remain unverified; zoo claims are attributed. Exact Yerkir report S010 is blocked by 403 and must not be retried; S021 may be a distinct municipality action.

Opened Armenpress body confirms a Jan. 31 Republic Square action demanding review of compulsory insurance price increases; police reported seven people taken to the station. Total attendance and whether the target was government policy or the Auto Insurers’ Bureau remain unresolved; no end or violence evidence.
Maralik memorial action is supported only by search discovery and an opinion item; whether it was a protest, its explicit state target, and turnout are unresolved.

State responses remain unknown for most candidates. Norq reporting describes a director meeting and ministry statement; the insurance report records seven people taken to police. Zoo pre-event management statement is not established as a state response to the protest. No response evidence for Jan. 13 or Maralik.
No LexisNexis All News search or comprehensive local newspaper archive review is documented; English, Armenian, and Russian public web searches cannot establish exhaustive event coverage.

Potential post-January continuations/outcomes need separate month evidence: Norq employment follow-up and drivers’ Feb. 7/18 actions are not coded as January continuations without evidence of a continuous episode.

Local-language coverage remains discovery-led for several candidates, and the local Coding Procedure was not available in the supplied materials; review wording/category choices against the official procedure if later located.
